name: What Is Wellhead Platform
subtopics: Equipment inventory and connections on a wellhead platform
notes: Short practitioner explainer that lists what sits on a wellhead platform and how it connects: christmas tree per well, a production manifold receiving well fluid from all wells, a lift-gas manifold feeding gas-lift wells, a water-injection manifold feeding injection wells, a test manifold with test separator and oil/gas/water measurement, and a pig launcher; fluids leave by subsea lines to a process platform. Useful as the plain-language chain; it names no ratings and no project. Page read 2026-11-27.
